singleRule._comment: HAPPY PATH: Single BS entry + single regular entry. BS 5:00-7:00(2h) at 2x. Regular 9:00-17:00(8h) at 1x. Gap 7:00-9:00 unallocated. BS pay=2*1*2=4, bill=2*2*2=8. Reg pay=8*1=8, bill=8*2=16. Total=12pay,24bill.

HAPPY PATH: Single entry spanning BS + gap + regular (boundary crossing). Entry 5:00-17:00. BS portion=5:00-7:00(2h). Gap=7:00-9:00(2h unallocated). Regular=9:00-17:00(8h). Same totals as 001 despite single entry.

HAPPY PATH: Single BS entry + multiple regular entries WITH GAP. BS 5:00-7:00(2h). Regular 9:00-12:00(3h)+13:00-17:00(4h)=7h. Gap 12:00-13:00 is unlogged time in regular. BS pay=4, Reg pay=7. Total=11pay,22bill.
HAPPY PATH: Single BS entry + multiple regular entries WITHOUT GAP. BS 5:00-7:00(2h). Regular 9:00-12:00(3h)+12:00-15:00(3h)+15:00-17:00(2h)=8h contiguous. Total=12pay,24bill.

HAPPY PATH: Multiple BS entries WITH GAP + single regular entry. BS 2:00-4:00(2h)+5:00-7:00(2h)=4h. Gap 4:00-5:00 within BS range but user didn't work. Regular 9:00-17:00(8h). BS pay=4*1*2=8, Reg pay=8. Total=16pay,32bill.
HAPPY PATH: Multiple BS entries WITHOUT GAP + single regular entry. BS 3:00-5:00(2h)+5:00-7:00(2h)=4h contiguous. Regular 9:00-17:00(8h). BS pay=8, Reg pay=8. Total=16pay,32bill.

HAPPY PATH: Multiple BS entries WITH GAP + multiple regular entries WITH GAP. BS 2:00-4:00(2h)+5:00-7:00(2h)=4h (gap 4-5). Regular 9:00-12:00(3h)+13:00-17:00(4h)=7h (gap 12-13). BS pay=8, Reg pay=7. Total=15pay,30bill.

HAPPY PATH: Multiple BS entries WITHOUT GAP + multiple regular entries WITHOUT GAP. BS 3:00-5:00(2h)+5:00-7:00(2h)=4h contiguous. Regular 9:00-12:00(3h)+12:00-15:00(3h)+15:00-17:00(2h)=8h contiguous. BS pay=8, Reg pay=8. Total=16pay,32bill.

HAPPY PATH: Multiple BS entries WITH GAP + multiple regular entries WITHOUT GAP. BS 2:00-4:00(2h)+5:00-7:00(2h)=4h (gap 4-5). Regular 9:00-12:00(3h)+12:00-15:00(3h)+15:00-17:00(2h)=8h contiguous. BS pay=8, Reg pay=8. Total=16pay,32bill.

HAPPY PATH: Multiple BS entries WITHOUT GAP + multiple regular entries WITH GAP. BS 3:00-5:00(2h)+5:00-7:00(2h)=4h contiguous. Regular 9:00-12:00(3h)+13:00-17:00(4h)=7h (gap 12-13). BS pay=8, Reg pay=7. Total=15pay,30bill.

HAPPY PATH: BOUNDARY CROSSING - single entry spans BS+gap+regular. Entry 6:00-10:00 splits as: BS 6:00-7:00(1h), gap 7:00-9:00(2h unallocated), regular 9:00-10:00(1h). Plus separate regular 12:00-17:00(5h). Total BS=1h, Reg=6h. BS pay=1*1*2=2, Reg pay=6*1=6. Total=8pay,16bill.

BS time=9:00 (NO GAP with regular). Entry crosses BS→regular boundary. 3:00-5:00(2h fully BS) + 7:00-9:30(BS 7:00-9:00=2h, regular 9:00-9:30=0.5h) + 10:00-17:00(7h regular). Total BS=4h, Reg=7.5h. BS pay=4*1*2=8, bill=4*2*2=16. Reg pay=7.5, bill=15. Total=15.5pay,31bill.

BS time=9:00 (NO GAP). Single entry spans full BS→regular seamlessly. Entry 5:00-17:00. BS=5:00-9:00(4h). Regular=9:00-17:00(8h). No gap between BS and regular since BS ends exactly where regular starts. BS pay=8, Reg pay=8. Total=16pay,32bill.

BS time=9:00 (NO GAP). Multiple BS entries (with gap) + boundary crossing + multiple regular entries (with gap). 1:00-3:00(2h BS) + 5:00-9:30(BS 4h + Reg 0.5h) + 9:30-12:00(2.5h Reg) + 13:00-17:00(4h Reg). Total BS=6h, Reg=7h. BS pay=12, Reg pay=7. Total=19pay,38bill.

BS time=9:00 (NO GAP). Clean split at 9:00 boundary — entry ends exactly at BS end, next starts exactly at regular start. 5:00-9:00(4h fully BS) + 9:00-17:00(8h fully regular). No boundary crossing. BS pay=8, Reg pay=8. Total=16pay,32bill.

BOUNDARY: Full BS range — work from near midnight to BS end. BS time=7:00. Entry 0:30-7:00(6.5h BS) + 9:00-17:00(8h reg). Tests maximum BS range utilization. BS pay=6.5*2=13, Reg pay=8. Total=21pay,42bill.
BOUNDARY: Work ONLY in BS range, ZERO regular hours. BS time=7:00. Entry 3:00-7:00(4h BS). User doesn't work during regular hours at all. BS pay=4*2=8, Reg=0. Total=8pay,16bill.

BOUNDARY: Entry starts exactly AT BS end (7:00). BS time=7:00. Entry 7:00-17:00. 7:00-9:00(2h gap/unallocated) + 9:00-17:00(8h regular). ZERO BS hours — 7:00 is the boundary, not inside BS range. BS pay=0, Reg pay=8. Total=8pay,16bill.

BOUNDARY: Entry overlaps BS end by small margin. BS time=7:00. Entry 6:30-7:15(45min total). BS portion=6:30-7:00(0.5h). Gap=7:00-7:15(0.25h unallocated). Only 0.5h counted as BS. BS pay=0.5*2=1, Reg=0. Total=1pay,2bill.

MULTI-DAY: Mon + Tue both with BS and regular. BS time=7:00. Mon: 5:00-7:00(2h BS)+9:00-17:00(8h reg). Tue: 4:00-7:00(3h BS)+9:00-15:00(6h reg). Mon total=12pay,24bill. Tue total=12pay,24bill. Grand total=24pay,48bill.

MULTI-DAY: Mon + Tue with BS time=9:00 (no gap). Mon: 7:00-9:30(BS 2h + Reg 0.5h)+10:00-17:00(7h reg)=Reg 7.5h. Tue: 6:00-9:00(3h BS)+9:00-12:00(3h reg)+13:00-17:00(4h reg)=Reg 7h. Mon: BS4+Reg7.5=11.5pay. Tue: BS6+Reg7=13pay. Total=24.5pay,49bill.

WEEKEND: BS applied on Saturday (day off — no regular hours). BS time=7:00, appliedDay includes sat. Sat: 3:00-7:00(4h BS). No regular hours on Sat. User paid only for BS work. BS pay=4*2=8, Reg=0. Total=8pay,16bill.

WEEKEND: BS on Sat + Sun + weekday Mon. BS time=7:00. Sat: 2:00-5:00(3h BS). Sun: 4:00-6:00(2h BS). Mon: 5:00-7:00(2h BS)+9:00-17:00(8h reg). Total BS=7h, Reg=8h. BS pay=7*2=14, Reg pay=8. Total=22pay,44bill.

singleRule._comment: WEEKEND: Sat work partly in BS, partly outside (unallocated). BS time=7:00. Sat: 5:00-10:00(5h total). BS=5:00-7:00(2h). Unallocated=7:00-10:00(3h — no regular on Sat, no other rules). Only BS is paid. BS pay=4, Reg=0. Total=4pay,8bill.
WEEKEND: Sat work entirely OUTSIDE BS range. BS time=7:00. Sat: 10:00-15:00(5h). All hours are outside BS(00:00-7:00) and no regular on Sat. Everything unallocated. Zero pay.

MAX 10 ENTRIES WITHOUT GAPS (contiguous). BS time=9:00 (no gap with regular). 5 contiguous BS entries: 3:00-4:00(1h)+4:00-5:00(1h)+5:00-6:00(1h)+6:00-7:00(1h)+7:00-9:00(2h)=6h BS. 5 contiguous regular entries: 9:00-10:30(1.5h)+10:30-12:00(1.5h)+12:00-13:30(1.5h)+13:30-15:00(1.5h)+15:00-17:00(2h)=8h reg. Total 10 entries, all seamless. BS pay=6*2=12, Reg pay=8. Total=20pay,40bill.
BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=0. Break in BS only. BS 5:00-7:00(2h), break 5:30-6:00(0.5h). BS work=1.5h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) no break. Breaks unpaid. BS pay=1.5*2=3, Reg pay=8. Total=11pay,22bill.
BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=0. Break in REGULAR only. BS 5:00-7:00(2h) no break. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h), break 12:00-13:00(1h). Reg work=7h. Breaks unpaid. BS pay=4, Reg pay=7. Total=11pay,22bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=0. Breaks in BOTH BS and regular. BS 5:00-7:00(2h), break 5:30-6:00(0.5h), BS work=1.5h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h), break 12:00-13:00(1h), Reg work=7h. All breaks unpaid. BS pay=3, Reg pay=7. Total=10pay,20bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=0. Multiple entries WITH GAP + breaks in both zones. BS: 2:00-4:00(2h) break 2:30-3:00(0.5h) + 5:00-7:00(2h) break 6:00-6:30(0.5h). BS work=3h. Reg: 9:00-12:00(3h) + 13:00-17:00(4h) break 15:00-15:30(0.5h). Reg work=6.5h. BS pay=6, Reg pay=6.5. Total=12.5pay,25bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=0. Multiple entries WITHOUT GAP (contiguous) + breaks. BS: 3:00-5:00(2h) + 5:00-7:00(2h) break 6:00-6:30(0.5h). BS work=3.5h. Reg: 9:00-12:00(3h) + 12:00-15:00(3h) break 13:00-13:30(0.5h) + 15:00-17:00(2h). Reg work=7.5h. BS pay=7, Reg pay=7.5. Total=14.5pay,29bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. Break in reg = 1h = anticipated (EQUALS). Effective regular=8-1=7h. Reg work=8-1=7h=effective. No BS break. BS 5:00-7:00(2h) work=2h. BS pay=4, Reg pay=7. Total=11pay,22bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. Break in reg=1h=anticipated (EQUALS) + break in BS too. BS 5:00-7:00(2h), break 5:30-6:00(0.5h), BS work=1.5h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h), break 12:00-13:00(1h). Effective regular=7h. Reg work=7h=effective. BS break separate from anticipated. BS pay=3, Reg pay=7. Total=10pay,20bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. Break in reg=2h > anticipated (MORE than anticipated). Effective regular=7h. Actual reg work=8-2=6h < effective. Paid for actual work only=6h. No BS break. BS 5:00-7:00(2h) work=2h. BS pay=4, Reg pay=6. Total=10pay,20bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. Break in reg=1.5h > anticipated (MORE) + BS break. BS 5:00-7:00(2h), break 6:00-6:30(0.5h), BS work=1.5h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h), breaks 12:00-12:30(0.5h)+14:00-15:00(1h)=1.5h. Reg work=6.5h < effective(7h). Paid actual=6.5h. BS pay=3, Reg pay=6.5. Total=9.5pay,19bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. Break in reg=0.5h < anticipated (LESS than anticipated). Effective regular=7h. Actual reg work=8-0.5=7.5h > effective. Reg CAPPED at effective=7h. Excess 0.5h unpaid (no OT rule). No BS break. BS 5:00-7:00(2h) work=2h. BS pay=4, Reg pay=7. Total=11pay,22bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. NO break taken at all (0 < anticipated). Effective regular=7h. Actual reg work=8h > effective. Reg CAPPED at 7h. Excess 1h unpaid (no OT). No BS break. BS 5:00-7:00(2h) work=2h. BS pay=4, Reg pay=7. Total=11pay,22bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=2h. Break in reg=0.5h < anticipated (LESS with large anticipated). Effective regular=8-2=6h. Actual reg work=7.5h > effective. Reg CAPPED at 6h. Excess 1.5h unpaid. BS 5:00-7:00(2h), break 5:30-6:00(0.5h), BS work=1.5h. BS pay=3, Reg pay=6. Total=9pay,18bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. Multiple BS WITH GAP + multiple reg WITH GAP + breaks. BS: 2:00-4:00(2h) break 2:30-3:00(0.5h) + 5:00-7:00(2h). BS work=3.5h. Reg: 9:00-12:00(3h) break 10:00-10:30(0.5h) + 13:00-17:00(4h) break 15:00-15:30(0.5h). Reg entries=7h, reg break=1h=anticipated, reg work=6h. Effective=7h. Reg pay=6h. BS pay=7, Reg pay=6. Total=13pay,26bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. Multiple BS WITHOUT GAP + multiple reg WITHOUT GAP + breaks. BS: 3:00-5:00(2h) break 4:00-4:30(0.5h) + 5:00-7:00(2h). BS work=3.5h. Reg: 9:00-12:00(3h) + 12:00-15:00(3h) break 13:00-13:30(0.5h) + 15:00-17:00(2h). Reg=8h, break=0.5h < anticipated(1h), work=7.5h. Effective=7h. Reg CAPPED at 7h. BS pay=7, Reg pay=7. Total=14pay,28bill.

EDGE CASE: Break in UNALLOCATED gap zone (not paid, not counted). anticipated=1h. Entry1 5:00-10:00 spans BS+gap+reg. Breaks: 6:30-7:00(0.5h in BS) + 7:30-8:00(0.5h in gap=ignored). Entry2 10:00-17:00(7h) break 12:00-13:00(1h). BS work=1.5h. Reg=8h, reg break=1h=anticipated, reg work=7h=effective. BS pay=3, Reg pay=7. Total=10pay,20bill.

EDGE CASE: MAX 10 BREAKS in single BS entry. anticipated=1h. BS 1:00-7:00(6h), 10 breaks x 0.25h=2.5h, BS work=3.5h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h), break 12:00-13:00(1h)=anticipated. Reg work=7h=effective. BS pay=7, Reg pay=7. Total=14pay,28bill.

BOUNDARY: Break SPANNING BS→gap boundary (crosses 7:00). anticipated=0. Entry 5:00-9:00(4h), break 6:30-7:30(1h). BS portion break=0.5h, gap portion=0.5h(both unpaid). BS work=1.5h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) no break. BS pay=3, Reg pay=8. Total=11pay,22bill.

BOUNDARY: BS time=9:00 (no gap). Break SPANNING BS→regular boundary (crosses 9:00). anticipated=1h. Entry 7:00-10:00(3h), break 8:30-9:30(1h). BS: 7:00-9:00=2h, BS break 8:30-9:00=0.5h, BS work=1.5h. Reg: 9:00-10:00 break 9:00-9:30=0.5h, work=0.5h + Entry 10:00-17:00(7h). Total reg work=7.5h. Effective=7h. Reg break(0.5h) < anticipated(1h). Reg CAPPED at 7h. BS pay=3, Reg pay=7. Total=10pay,20bill.
WEEKEND: Sat BS with break. anticipated=0. No regular hours on Sat (day off). Sat 3:00-7:00(4h BS), break 4:00-5:00(1h). BS work=3h. Break unpaid. BS pay=6. Total=6pay,12bill.

WEEKEND + WEEKDAY multi-day. anticipated=1h. Sat: 2:00-6:00(4h BS) break 3:00-4:00(1h), BS work=3h (anticipated has no effect on day off). Mon: 5:00-7:00(2h BS) + 9:00-17:00(8h reg) break 12:00-13:00(1h). Mon BS work=2h. Reg break=1h=anticipated, effective=7h, reg work=7h. Sat: BS pay=6. Mon: BS pay=4, Reg pay=7. Grand total=17pay,34bill.

MAX 10 ENTRIES WITH GAPS + breaks. anticipated=1h. 4 BS entries: 1:00-2:00 break 1:15-1:30(0.25h) + 2:30-3:30 + 4:00-5:00 break 4:15-4:30(0.25h) + 5:30-7:00. BS=4.5h, break=0.5h, work=4h. 6 reg entries: 9:00-10:00 + 10:30-11:30 break 10:45-11:00(0.25h) + 12:00-13:00 + 13:30-14:30 break 14:00-14:15(0.25h) + 15:00-16:00 + 16:30-17:00. Reg=5.5h, break=0.5h<anticipated(1h), work=5h. Effective=7h. Reg work(5h)<effective. Reg pay=5. BS pay=8, Reg pay=5. Total=13pay,26bill.

MAX 10 ENTRIES WITHOUT GAPS (contiguous) + breaks. BS time=9:00. anticipated=1h. 5 BS entries: 3:00-4:00 break 3:15-3:30(0.25h) + 4:00-5:00 + 5:00-6:00 break 5:15-5:30(0.25h) + 6:00-7:00 + 7:00-9:00 break 8:00-8:30(0.5h). BS=6h, break=1h, work=5h. 5 reg entries: 9:00-10:30 + 10:30-12:00 break 11:00-11:30(0.5h) + 12:00-13:30 + 13:30-15:00 break 14:00-14:30(0.5h) + 15:00-17:00. Reg=8h, break=1h=anticipated, work=7h=effective. BS pay=10, Reg pay=7. Total=17pay,34bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=0. Single BS 3:00-7:00(4h) multiple CONTIGUOUS breaks 4:00-4:30+4:30-5:00=1h(no gap). BS work=3h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) break 12:00-13:00(1h). Reg work=7h. All breaks unpaid. BS pay=6, Reg pay=7. Total=13pay,26bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=0. Single BS 3:00-7:00(4h) multiple SPACED breaks 3:30-4:00+5:30-6:00=1h(with gap). BS work=3h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) break 12:00-13:00(1h). Reg work=7h. BS pay=6, Reg pay=7. Total=13pay,26bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. Single BS 3:00-7:00(4h) contiguous breaks 4:00-4:30+4:30-5:00=1h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) break 12:00-13:00(1h)=anticipated(EQUALS). Effective reg=7h. Reg work=7h=effective. BS pay=6, Reg pay=7. Total=13pay,26bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. Single BS 3:00-7:00(4h) contiguous breaks 4:00-4:30+4:30-5:00=1h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) breaks 12:00-13:00+14:00-15:00=2h>anticipated(MORE). Effective reg=7h. Reg work=8-2=6h<effective. Paid actual=6h. BS pay=6, Reg pay=6. Total=12pay,24bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. Single BS 3:00-7:00(4h) contiguous breaks 4:00-4:30+4:30-5:00=1h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) break 12:00-12:30(0.5h)<anticipated(LESS). Effective reg=7h. Reg work=7.5h>effective. Reg CAPPED at 7h. Excess 0.5h unpaid. BS pay=6, Reg pay=7. Total=13pay,26bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=0. PARTIAL REGULAR: User enters 9:00-13:00(4h) instead of full 9:00-17:00(8h). BS 5:00-7:00(2h) no break. Reg break 11:00-12:00(1h). Reg work=3h. No anticipated cap. BS pay=4, Reg pay=3. Total=7pay,14bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. PARTIAL REGULAR 9:00-13:00(4h). Break 11:00-12:00(1h)=anticipated(EQUALS). Effective reg=7h. Reg work=3h<effective. No cap needed. BS 5:00-7:00(2h) no break. BS pay=4, Reg pay=3. Total=7pay,14bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. PARTIAL REGULAR 9:00-13:00(4h). Breaks 10:00-10:30+11:00-12:00=1.5h>anticipated(MORE). Effective reg=7h. Reg work=4-1.5=2.5h<effective. Paid actual=2.5h. BS 5:00-7:00(2h) no break. BS pay=4, Reg pay=2.5. Total=6.5pay,13bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=1h. PARTIAL REGULAR 9:00-13:00(4h). Break 11:00-11:30(0.5h)<anticipated(LESS). Effective reg=7h. Reg work=3.5h<effective(7h). No cap triggered (3.5<7). BS 5:00-7:00(2h) no break. BS pay=4, Reg pay=3.5. Total=7.5pay,15bill.

BREAK PAID NO, anticipated=3h. PARTIAL REGULAR 9:00-15:00(6h) with large anticipated. Effective reg=8-3=5h. Break 12:00-12:30(0.5h)<anticipated(LESS). Reg work=5.5h>effective(5h). Reg CAPPED at 5h. This proves partial reg CAN trigger cap with large anticipated. BS 5:00-7:00(2h) no break. BS pay=4, Reg pay=5. Total=9pay,18bill.

BREAK PAID NO: Contiguous breaks in regular (no gap between breaks). anticipated=1h. BS 5:00-7:00(2h) no break, BS work=2h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h), breaks 12:00-12:30+12:30-13:00=1h contiguous=anticipated(EQUALS). Effective=7h. Reg work=7h=effective. BS pay=4, Reg pay=7. Total=11pay,22bill.

BREAK PAID NO: MULTI-DAY Mon+Tue weekdays with anticipated=1h. Mon: BS 5:00-7:00(2h), Reg 9:00-17:00(8h) break 12:00-13:00(1h)=anticipated. Reg work=7h. Tue: BS 4:00-7:00(3h) break 5:00-5:30(0.5h), BS work=2.5h. Reg 9:00-14:00(5h) break 11:00-12:00(1h)=anticipated. Reg work=4h<effective(7h). BS pay Mon=4+Tue=5=9. Reg pay Mon=7+Tue=4=11. Total=20pay,40bill.

BREAK PAID NO: Only BS on weekday (no regular entry). anticipated=1h. Mon is a working day but user only enters BS hours. BS 3:00-7:00(4h), break 4:00-5:00(1h), BS work=3h. No reg entry so anticipated has no effect. BS pay=6. Total=6pay,12bill.

BREAK PAID NO: BS fully consumed by break (0 BS work). anticipated=1h. BS 5:00-6:00(1h), break 5:00-6:00(1h). BS work=0h. Reg 9:00-17:00(8h), break 12:00-13:00(1h)=anticipated. Effective=7h. Reg work=7h. BS pay=0, Reg pay=7. Total=7pay,14bill.

GAP1-NoBrk: 7 ENTRIES with gaps (mid-range entry count). BS time=7:00. 3 BS entries with gaps: 1:00-2:00(1h)+3:00-4:30(1.5h)+5:30-7:00(1.5h)=4h BS. 4 Reg entries with gaps: 9:00-10:30(1.5h)+11:00-13:00(2h)+14:00-16:00(2h)+16:30-17:00(0.5h)=6h Reg. Total 7 entries. BS pay=4*2=8, Reg pay=6. Total=14pay,28bill.

GAP1-BPN: 7 ENTRIES with gaps + breaks. anticipated=1h. BS time=7:00. 3 BS entries: 1:00-2:00(1h) brk 1:15-1:30(0.25h) + 3:00-4:30(1.5h) + 5:30-7:00(1.5h) brk 6:00-6:30(0.5h). BS=4h, BS brk=0.75h, BS work=3.25h. 4 Reg entries: 9:00-10:30(1.5h)+11:00-13:00(2h) brk 12:00-12:30(0.5h)+14:00-16:00(2h)+16:30-17:00(0.5h). Reg=6h, brk=0.5h<ant(1h). Effective=7h. Reg work=6-0.5=5.5h<7h→paid 5.5h. BS pay=6.50, Reg pay=5.50. Total=12pay,24bill.
